pol_1_desc: Fire the high command responsible for Oct 7th. The purpose of war is decisive victory—not managing endless rounds of fighting to maintain a status quo, trapped in a vicious loop where our sons, daughters, and friends die for nothing.
pol_2_desc: Full income tax exemption for one year for any combat reservist who served over 100 days. Use the Reservist Shield calculator in this app to see exactly how much you are owed. The state pays the heroes.
pol_3_desc: Implement the Swiss Model: massive arming and mandatory basic training for ALL eligible citizens, including Haredim. A defense squad on every street.
pol_4_title: The Land Belongs to the People
pol_4_desc: Stop the plunder of state land. If we are forced into war, whoever fights for the state receives land. Whoever fights against the state won't get a single centimeter. Whatever we win in blood, we keep.
pol_5_desc: Total cancellation of the Oslo Accords. Full Israeli sovereignty over the entire land, and absolute freedom of Jewish worship on the Temple Mount. We are done apologizing for who we are.
pol_6_desc: Smash the monopolies. Absolute opening of the market to parallel imports to crush the cartels, slash the cost of living, and return money to the citizens.
pol_7_desc: While Jews beg for pistol licenses, the Arab sector holds military arsenals. We will launch Operation Defensive Shield 2 to confiscate all illegal weapons inside Israel.
pol_8_desc: A clear Jewish identity as the engine of our national resilience. Less state coercion, more freedom for the citizen, and unapologetic national pride.
